summary: Prose is already in strong shape: a distinctive, disciplined voice; parallel structures (three design decisions, three scenarios) that aid scanning; abstract numbers that reconcile exactly with Section 4 and the Figure 3 strip; and the parts (322) vs. papers (100) distinction never blurs. Remaining work is line-level: two 50+-word abstract sentences that split for free at their semicolons; a handful of agency/parallelism faults (Sections 2.3 and 4); scattered terminology drift (routing vs. organization skill, out-of-corpus vs. absent-paper, six vs. 6, direct vs. cited answer, score-five vs. score-5); and one submission-blocking layout fact: Section 4 body text spills roughly 13 lines onto page 5, against the stated 4-page body limit (only the GenAI disclosure and references may overflow). Every fix below is local wording; none touches the story or adds content.
strengths: Parallel architecture carries the reader end to end: the three design decisions in Section 1 map one-to-one onto the three demo scenarios and the three-mode results, and the abstract's scenario triad matches Section 3's paragraph headings verbatim.

The parts/documents distinction is maintained everywhere: 322 stored parts vs. 100 papers never blur, and the parenthetical '(35 near-pairs are parts of the same paper)' pre-empts the obvious misreading.
Every number in the abstract reconciles with Section 4 and the Figure 3 bottom strip (9/10 grounded, 10/10 bare-agent location, 6/10 keyword verification, 7--4--1 citation split, 113 s / $0.49 cost).

Typography discipline is high: non-breaking ties before every \ref, en-dashes in all ranges (0--8, 7--4--1, November 9--11), and consistent hyphenation of content-guided, word-boundary, keyword-verified.
Limitations are stated plainly and memorably ('Correctness reflects our reading; the comparison is operational, not controlled') rather than buried.

issues.location: sec4_eval.tex:50-61 (Costs and limitations) / pages/page-5.png, top of left column
issues.issue: Not a wording fault but it blocks submission: the Costs and limitations paragraph continues for about 13 lines onto page 5, above the GenAI disclosure. By the paper's own stated rule (main.tex header comment: body must be <=4 pages; only the disclosure and references may extend beyond), Section 4 body text on page 5 violates the limit. The line edits below recover only 3-4 lines, so roughly a column-inch must also come from captions or figure height.
issues.evidence: 48 s/$0.18 dense): the gap is bought with multi-step reading, visible in the traces.
issues.suggestion: Reclaim about a column-inch before submission: apply the R6 line edits (about 3-4 lines), tighten the Figure 2 caption (the art already states the 6/5/4 branches, so 'After reassessment, usable score-5 evidence can support an attributed backstop answer; no usable evidence yields not-found.' is cuttable), and if still short, reduce Figure 3 from 0.92\textwidth so Section 4 ends on page 4.

issues.issue: 64-word sentence doing two jobs (organization skill; retrieval skill). The semicolon carries a load a period should carry; splitting costs zero space and lets the escalation chain read as its own arc.
issues.evidence: Packaged agent skills call tool APIs to parse documents, route them by content into category bases, and maintain tags; retrieval rewrites each query
issues.suggestion: Packaged agent skills call tool APIs to parse documents, route them by content into category bases, and maintain tags. Retrieval rewrites each query, recalls and reads candidates, gates them with a prompted 0--8 rubric (topic, scenario, evidence), and --- when nothing passes --- escalates from ranking to browsing base summaries and tag-matched shelves, returning a scoped not-found report instead of answering from the nearest neighbor.

issues.issue: Second 55-word sentence stacks all three modes' results in one breath. A period after the platform's figure lets each mode land; still zero net space cost.
issues.evidence: the platform grounds 9 of 10 designated-paper answers and keyword-verifies 9 of 10; the bare agent locates the designated paper in all 10 cases
issues.suggestion: the platform grounds 9 of 10 designated-paper answers and keyword-verifies 9 of 10. The bare agent locates the designated paper in all 10 cases yet passes conservative word-boundary verification in only 6, and dense retrieval grounds 9 and verifies 6.
